build_transformer_sentence_encoder: build a bidirectional Transformer sentence encoder for BERT style pre-trained models with token and segment embeddings
create_encoder_with_bert_init: create a TransformerSentenceEncoder with BERT weight initialization using normal distribution with std 0.02
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the encoder with tokens and segment labels to get inner states and sentence representation
freeze_encoder_embeddings: freeze the token, segment, and position embeddings of the encoder for transfer learning fine-tuning
review_init_bert_params: review the init_bert_params function that initializes Linear, Embedding, and MultiheadAttention weights with normal distribution
